subject: [video] WP07 READY v1: all probe files written, host + iOS compile/link green (44/44)
body:
All owned WP07 files exist: probe_core.{h,c}, probe_main.c, probe_apple.h, probe_vt.c (T01,T02 avc1/hvc1/av01/mp4v, T03 7 cases, T03b 4 cases, T04), probe_img.c (T05 jpeg/heic/png + golden jpeg/heic, T06 cmphoto dlsym), probe_audio.c (T07), com.nord2.videoprobe.plist, symbols.txt (137 symbols, 8 libraries), test/{t_core.c,run_tests.sh,iosinc/}.

'bash gpu/video/probe/test/run_tests.sh' -> 'N2TEST WP07 PASS 44/44' in 9 s. It now does three things: (1) host runner test under ASan+UBSan (38 checks: six-test fork runner with pass/fail/skip/timeout(1s)/crash, python3 re-parses every JSON line, escaping round-trip, RFC1321 vectors incl. 10^6 'a', literal NV12 samples, PSNR 99.0/48.1308/57.16, output numbering); (2) compiles all five probe/*.c for arm64-apple-ios16.0 with -Werror against probe/test/iosinc (test scaffolding, NOT sdk/); links build/WP07/ios/n2vt_probe from TBDs generated from probe/symbols.txt, LC_MAIN present, and asserts the linked imports are EXACTLY the 137 lines of symbols.txt; (3) plist check (Label com.nord2.videoprobe, RunAtLoad, root, Background, no KeepAlive, StandardErrorPath).

Notes for the lead: (a) WP09's vectors/embedded_vectors.h is already there with flat names; I adapted with a small runtime adapter, no change requested. (b) WP01: build_ios.sh must compile probe/probe_main.c with -DPROBE_NO_AV and all five objects, link as a MAIN executable (-e _main) with the union TBDs; my local TBD experiment uses install names '/usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib', CoreFoundation, CoreMedia, CoreVideo, VideoToolbox, ImageIO, CoreGraphics, AudioToolbox exactly as in symbols.txt. (c) Every VT dictionary key is fetched by dlsym (kVTVideoEncoderList_* excepted: those four are linked directly), so a missing private constant becomes a reported -1, not a crash. Unfinished: STATUS.json/STATUS.md (next), and a review of the encode test's 30-frame cost at 1080p (timeout 180 s).
